plan.title: Review-cycle: Greptile CLEAN + ci_failures forces CI fix (no idle-poll)

narratives.Description: drive-to:merge-ready workers idle-poll when Greptile is CLEAN and clean_gate_holdout=ci_failures. Add review-cycle skill doctrine (CI annotation fetch + fix batch; checkboxes != merge-ready; review-monitor carve-out). Optionally surface failing check names in pr:watch JSON and fail-loud (CI_BLOCKED/STALL) instead of burning max-wait.
narratives.Overview: Dogfood PR #2687 / #2683 — Greptile CLEAN, CodeQL red, worker parked until interrupt.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Edit skills-pack review-cycle body + packs:render. 2. Contract tests for new MUST lines. 3. pr:watch: expose ci_failed_checks; early CI_BLOCKED when holdout stable. 4. CHANGELOG.
narratives.UserStory: As a merge-ready worker, when Greptile is CLEAN and CI is red I must fix CI immediately instead of idle-polling.

narrative.Acceptance: Review-cycle skill mandates exit Greptile wait and fix/escalate on clean_gate_holdout=ci_failures; Greptile CLEAN+CI red has same ownership as Greptile P0; test-plan checkboxes do not authorize idle wait.
Review-monitor guidance does not strand workers on spawn-monitor when sole holdout is CI after Greptile CLEAN on HEAD.
Content-contract tests assert new markers; CHANGELOG cites #2688; pr:watch JSON includes failing check identities when ci_failures>0.
